statement: The implementing agent has its own Prism ID, linked to the maintainer's Prism ID, and acts inside Verdant Studio's runtime as a Contributor under Verdant Engine's governance: it submits signed, content-addressed permission requests scoped to what it may change, and the maintainer grants them or approves its work. This supersedes the GitHub App pull requests and owner approval of REQ-AGENT-IDENTITY; the GitHub App only pushes the mirror when a release is published.
All communication and coordination between the maintainer and the implementing agent move into Verdant, so that every interaction between them happens through the Verdant Studio UI.
